heroSummary: Forsyth County Schools students start the 2027–28 school year on Thursday, August 5, 2027, and finish on Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break is September 27 through October 1, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Holiday Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7.
calendarNotes: The official Forsyth County Schools 2027–28 student calendar lists 178 student days: 85 in the first semester and 93 in the second semester. K–12 early-release days are September 3, December 17, May 24, and May 25. Online learning and parent conference dates are October 15 and March 17. Professional development days when students do not attend are October 18, January 3, February 22, and March 20.

If we find a mismatch, we correct the page and update the review date. Campus-specific bell schedules, testing dates, staff details, and program events may appear only in the official PDF or individual school calendars.
The downloadable calendar file is a one-time import generated from the calendar records used for this page, and the official district calendar remains the source of record for last-minute changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend school in person on FCS Online Learning days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. On October 15, 2027, and March 17, 2028, students follow the district's online learning and parent conference schedule rather than a normal in-person school day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do early-release times vary by school level?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Elementary I schools dismiss at 11:50 a.m., Elementary II schools at 12:30 p.m., middle schools at 1:30 p.m., high schools at 12:55 p.m., and Alliance Academy at 12:20 p.m.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after Holiday Break and the February student holiday?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return from Holiday Break on Tuesday, January 4, 2028, after a January 3 professional development day. After the February 18–21 student and staff holiday and the February 22 professional development day, students return Wednesday, February 23.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Forsyth County Schools calendar page and the current district PDF before making travel, child care, transportation, or school-specific plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and will not automatically reflect later changes made by Forsyth County Schools.

customSections.label: What Forsyth Families Need to Know
customSections.content: Several dates change the normal school-day schedule and may affect child care, transportation, or after-school plans.

groups.label: Schedule changes to plan for
items: Friday, September 3, is a K–12 early-release day before the Labor Day weekend. Schools are closed Monday, September 6.
Students learn online Friday, October 15, and do not attend school Monday, October 18, because of professional development.
Students learn online Friday, March 17, and do not attend school Monday, March 20, because of professional development.

groups.label: Break return dates
items: Students return from Holiday Break on Tuesday, January 4, after the January 3 professional development day.
After the February 18–21 student and staff holiday and the February 22 professional development day, students return Wednesday, February 23.

groups.label: Early-release times
items: Early-release times vary by school group. Elementary I schools dismiss at 11:50 a.m., Elementary II schools at 12:30 p.m., middle schools at 1:30 p.m., high schools at 12:55 p.m., and Alliance Academy at 12:20 p.m.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2026–27 Calendar
customSections.content: Compared with 2026–27, four calendar changes stand out for Forsyth families.

rows: School starts August 5 instead of August 6
The first week has two instructional days, Thursday and Friday, and begins one day earlier than in 2026–27.
School ends May 25 instead of May 27
The last student day falls two days earlier in May and is on a Thursday.
K–12 early-release days increase from three to four
Families have an additional K–12 early-release date on May 24, followed by another early release on the final student day, May 25.
The break starts two days earlier than 2026–27 Spring Break.
